newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grains track sterling, wheat lower.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grains track sterling, wheat lower.

text.p: LIFFE wheat eased in thin trade in a market which was concentrating on watching sterling's moves.
Many market players, in futures and the physical market, chose to sit back and do nothing because of the uncertainty of the currency market, traders said.
On wheat, active November last traded 0.40 sterling lower at 86.60 stg. November volume was 61 lots of a meagre total of 176.
Barley was mixed. January was the most active, with 40 of the total 56 lots. It last traded 0.25 stg higher at 80.75.
"Sterling has stifled the market," one trader said. "People are just tracking sterling," another said.

Sterling climbed to session highs against the mark in thin afternoon European trade. It stood at 2.9254/64, over three pfennigs up on early session lows and well above Wednesday's late European level of 2.9008/18.
